## Analysis

Scanning for abnormally short inter‑residue heavy‑atom contacts, most packing contacts in this helical structure fall at normal van der Waals separations (3.4–4.5 Å for C···C, ~2.7–3.0 Å for polar pairs). A few candidates were checked closely:

| Atom pair | distance (Å) | overlap (Bondi, −0.40) |
|---|---|---|
| A:D27 OD1 – A:T29 OG1 | 2.82 | −0.18 |
| A:H10 ND1 – A:H51 ND1 | 2.94 | −0.24 |
| A:E5 OE1 – A:H2 N | 2.73 | −0.06 |
| **A:K79 NZ – A:E83 OE1** | **2.06** | **+0.61** |

The lysine–glutamate ion pair between K79 and E83 (i, i+4 on the same helix) is far shorter (2.06 Å) than even a tight hydrogen bond, giving an overlap of 1.55 + 1.52 − 0.40 − 2.06 ≈ 0.61 Å — the largest positive overlap found anywhere in the model (next closest atoms of the same pair, NZ···CD = 3.03 Å and NZ···OE2 = 3.40 Å, are not in clash).

FINAL: A:K79--A:E83
